result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 301's regression check passed. Round 302 is the first half of the product rename to "CZABA Studio" (Saba's Q4). I changed only planning files; the store repo is untouched (HEAD `aa7a6ef`, clean tree).

**Round 301 results (C's evidence)**
- 133 browser checks passed at both screen sizes, with 0 failures. The perf run (run on its own) and the smoke test also passed, and the sign-in protection still holds.
- 7 checks couldn't run because there's no backend in the cloud; they don't count against the round.
- The publish gate skipped round 301 because no source changed, so round 302 starts from `aa7a6ef`.
- `regression-last.json` is now 2026-11-02 / round 301, so the next regression round is due on or after 2026-11-05.
- One Low bug, C-R301-01: after a mouse-opened grid menu, Tab lands on the page body instead of a control. It worked in round 258. It goes to the deferred Low list; its cause isn't confirmed.
- The perf comparison showed 9 small growth numbers (about 12 more page elements and 2.9 KB more script). I accepted them as the expected cost of features shipped in rounds 286–300; every budget still passes, and round 301's results become the new comparison point.
- The previous task is archived as `tasks/round-301.md` (an exact copy).

**Round 302: NAME-AND-HINT-a.** I split NAME-AND-HINT into two rounds because naming and the one-time hint touch different code. The hint (Q5) is scheduled for round 303, not deferred.

| Place | After |
|---|---|
| Studio browser tab title | `CZABA Studio — Demo collection` |
| Studio heading | `CZABA Studio` ("· Workspace" removed) |
| Home page heading | `CZABA Studio` (highlight stays on "Studio") |
| Home mockup window title | `CZABA Studio` |
| Checkout success, third line | `Access CZABA Studio anytime` |

- A also adds a test that fails if any old name ("Personal Mixdown", "Studio Lab", "· Workspace") comes back in the app.
- I ran the exact change on a scratch copy. 24 test files (361 tests) and the typecheck passed. Each of the 4 deliberately broken versions made the expected tests fail. A must apply the 11 code and test files byte-for-byte, plus a new implementation doc (221).
- C checks in the browser at both screen sizes:
  - the tab title, heading and header row;
  - that no old name appears anywhere;
  - the home page (also on a 390 px phone and with reduced motion) and the checkout success page;
  - the nav link, the narrow screen and the export file name;
  - the full path: home → Studio → add a clip, play → export → back home;
  - that the screen gains no permanent text: round 300 counted 96 lines at 1440×900 and 79 at 1280×720, and both should stay the same.

**Kept on purpose, with a question for Saba**
- **Export file name and URL:** the product-designer suggested renaming the download to `czaba-studio-demo`. I kept `czaba-studio-lab` and the `/studio-lab` URL because Q4 doesn't list them and a file name is something users and the perf test rely on. Question SABA-Q-NAME-LAB-URL-FILE: rename them in a later round, or keep them?
- **Testimonial:** the customer quote still says "The Mixdown Studio", because testimonials are on the keep-list. Question SABA-Q-NAME-TESTIMONIAL; the suggested answer is to keep it.

Also recorded but not in scope: 8 docs that still use the old names, and an outdated e2e test expecting a "Personal Studio Included" badge the app no longer shows.

**Waiting on root:** the frontend-architect review requested when STUDIO-LINK finished still hasn't been done (now listed as ARCH-CHECKPOINT-STUDIO-LINK). It doesn't block anything.

**Order after 302:** round 303 is the hint, then the remaining performance work, STEM-LANES, SYS-1…3 and STORE-2b…5. The retrospective is at round 305.

**Consults:** the advisor was available and I consulted it twice; I followed its fixes, including running the fourth broken version and the extra colour tests. I also consulted the product-designer. I found no Ableton manual source on product naming, so the task claims none.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-301.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json
- feature-status.md
- regression-last.json
- b-round-301/
